QuestInfo.name: Identity Crisis
QuestInfo.0: You've regained much of your strength, but your memory is still missing. \r\n#p2300000#, #p2159391#, and other Xeneroids don't seem to care much about their pasts. Seems like YOU'RE the only one bothered by this...
QuestInfo.1: You've regained much of your strength, but your memory is still missing. \r\n#p2300000#, #p2159391#, and other Xeneroids don't seem to care much about their pasts. Seems like YOU'RE the only one bothered by this... What should you do? Maybe Roo-D will have some advice.
QuestInfo.2: #p2300000# says that it's up to you to decide your future. How far are you willing to go to get your memories back? Guess it's time to finish your 4th Job Advancement...

0.0: My strength is coming back, but my memories still hang just out of reach. The child in Edelstein knows more about me than I do...
0.1: #p2300000# and #p2159391# seem content to live without their memories. Am I an anomaly? Wouldn't I be happier to just live as the Xenoroids do and throw aside this search for a past I may not even have had?

yes.0: Roo-D knows what I've been through. Perhaps she can help me put this in perspective.

no.0: Maybe I should find a snack first. Roo-D's probably going to talk my ear off.
